description: The optional word IS of the RD CODE clause (kb/Work PB5242). ANSI X3.23-1985's format is `CODE literal-1` (§1985:XIII.3.6.2), with no IS; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 prints `CODE IS {literal-1 | identifier-1}` (13.16.12.1), and Annex F.2 item 115 lists "CODE IS identifier added". The identifier operand is refused at COBOL-85 by its own syntax rule (COBOL2713, ReportSectionBinder.BindCodeClause, kb/Work PB5078); this row is the word IS. Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitReportCodeClause, once per written clause (VCR row 7.45 (f)).
display: the word IS of the CODE clause (report description)
citation: §1985:XIII.3.6.2 prints `CODE literal-1`; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.12.1 and Annex F.2 item 115; ISO §2023:13.18.12.2 (2023 text)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (f) - the word IS of the CODE clause (85->2002)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRCI.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "VMRCI.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WN PIC 9(3) VALUE 5.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 CODE IS "AB" PAGE LIMIT IS 10 LINES.
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(3) VALUE "ABC".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
